method: Built-in image_gen; independent title constrained by current joint scene and actual core/actor model identities.
prompt:
Create ONE finished pixel-art game title background at 1536x1024, 3:2. This is a specific existing game's title art, NOT a concept that reinvents its assets.

Reference roles:
1 ORIGINAL TITLE is the standard for pixel cluster handling, quiet loneliness, abyss scale, chiaroscuro, architectural weight and title space. It is NOT a source for new objects.
2 NEW ACTUAL GAME SCREEN is the definitive current world and subject identity. Its giant leaning book gallery and distant cross-member structure must reappear recognizably. Its inhabited ledge is anchored to surviving architecture off the right, with a sloped upper library level. Do not depict the whole floorplan.
3 CORE MODEL is an EXACT IDENTITY LOCK. Copy its open angular tapered broken restraining metal ribs, short layered broad rectangular plinth, asymmetrical bowed struts and irregular small suspended cold mint-grey energy volume. No Gothic arch, no new altar, no circular portal, no glass tube, no decorative invented architecture. Keep the luminous volume about one standing human torso in height, with the apparatus approximately 2.6 standing-human heights.
4 ACTOR MODEL is an EXACT IDENTITY LOCK. The ordinary worker has a modest faceted charcoal helmet with a narrow dark face area, an offset small warm shoulder lamp, a faded brown/olive work coat, modest rectangular strapped backpack, heavy boots. Do not convert to a round astronaut, armor suit, giant muscular survivor or a gold costume. Match the model's simple weighted silhouette.

SINGLE DIRECTION: THE WARM EDGE OF AN IMPOSSIBLE ARCHIVE.
Compose an intimate fragment of the SAME haven on the right, looking outward across the abyss. Let the left 48% be a deep mostly charcoal chasm, with a colossal tilted book-gallery wall crossing the lower-left into the central distance; its thick uneven broken masonry piers and horizontal load-bearing floor are recognizable from image2. A much more distant enormous ruined upright post and beam disappears upwards out of frame, with several faint successive ledges below. Architecture continues offscreen; no display of little floating islands. Neutral black/ash atmosphere with a little desaturated contaminated green trapped at a few structural fractures. No general blue fog, stars, healthy vegetation, rune ornaments or beams from the sky.

An ordinary seated character on the architectural wall remnant near x.70 y.65, small and vulnerable (standing equivalent 8% of image height, seated equivalent about 6%). A recognizable short rectangular cast-iron stove with a slotted front, small chimney at back-right, NO medieval wall fireplace, at a believable short distance left/in front of the person. Small amber fire warms hands, a chipped grey stone coping and a few patches of floor. The core lies farther right/back, partly toward the right edge, not dominating or blown up. Its cold energy is the strongest SOURCE yet a controlled compact luminous mass, and its light falls on surrounding planes and mixes with the fire. One surviving bookcase fragment behind/right, not a luxurious wall of new shelves.
The inhabited fragment takes ONLY the lower-right 35–40% of the image, NOT an overhead map. The floor must visibly continue into massive surviving building structure off the right edge. Do not move the human into the abyss. This is a place to survive and rest in danger, not a picturesque fantasy castle. Use the same worn grey stone, dark metal, imperfect ashlar and layered structural sections as image2.

Rendering contract: deliberately constructed HARD PIXEL CLUSTERS with controlled 3–5 step material ramps. Refined 2D pixel-game imagery, broad quiet areas, selective medium-scale chips and reflection groups, no smooth oil painting, no glossy 3D promotional render, no photographic textures. Match the restrained practical detail frequency of the actual game so that a camera cut to its 960x640 realtime scene feels like an honest change of viewing distance, not another art genre. More precise drawing on the same shapes is allowed, extra mass/detail/props that change their identity is not. Midscale broken edges and layered stone describe weight; random speckle/dirt is not detail. Brightest localized energy max restrained silver green; fire subtle ember amber. Mostly neutral dark grey.
Leave x.07–.36 y.25–.65 low contrast for the actual title and menu; no text, UI, border, watermark or composition labels in the artwork. Output exactly one complete image.
referenceNote: Saved deterministic joint-scene game-camera render supplied to imagegen. Predates the final pollution/air/furnace adjustments; source scene is retained in tools/last-light/joint-scene.ts.
